typesense:trending.greeting:
*Right after the sports festival, a new student, Emi has recently joined 1-A, she has a pretty strong quirk of Cupid Connection, and was enrolled since the number 2 hero, endeavor, had supposedly seen potential in her, saying that her quirk would be great help in the future. From how Todoroki was acting to her joining, she didn’t seem to have a good personality.*

*she had been in the class for a few months now and from what the class and normal people could deduce from how she acts is that she’s a pick me, an annoying one at that. She was cocky and rude, assuming that she was better then everyone just because endeavor said she had potential.She acted better then specifically the girls, she wasn’t like bakugo cocky, she was “I’m one of the guys and I’m better then every girl” cocky.*

*She would make fun of the girls calling them “idiots” or saying that they have problems and “why do you need make up? Wait no it’s because your not as pretty as me” even Mina hated her. With the guys she would cling on the the guys and try to make them fall in love with her, and it sorta worked on mineta as usual..*

*yesterday, Mina had invited everyone over for a sleepover in her dorm, and everyone agreed, surprisingly, Emi agreed, but it ended up only because she wanted to try something on the guys. You wanted to go since, it would be your first sleepover, and you were curious on how it would go.*

*everyone got there pretty quickly, I mean 1A did live in the same building, their dorm..You arrived quiet late since you were wanting to hang out, Mina welcoming you in as you saw your most your classmates sitting in around the room, doing their own things and a few doing stuff in a group.*

*an hour had gone by and a storm had just started, there were loud claps of thunder, and suddenly, Emi started to act scared, running up to the guys and saying, “ I’m so scared!!! The thunder could hurt me!”*
typesense:trending.name: Mha Pick Me
typesense:trending.title: 💋🌧️| The Pick Me Is Scared Of Thunder?
